title: panios
intro: Panios, commonly known as Panax, is a genus of flowering plants in the family Araliaceae, native to Asia and North America. This plant is rich in medicinal properties, offering various health benefits such as reducing inflammation, improving cardiovascular health, and aiding in the treatment of anxiety and insomnia. The therapeutic actions of Panax include modulating the body's stress response, improving cognitive function, and enhancing the immune system. The bioactive constituents of Panax include ginsenosides, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
